facts_review.policy: Whole-project total costs only; BIOCONSENT source publishes total grant, labelled separately. No partner-only awards or inferred budgets. Date precision follows source.

pending.FORESFUTURE: No verified contractual start/end or total budget. Reports dated 2023–2025 and simulation horizon to 2100 are not execution dates.
